title: AIOW commercial control plane v1
description: Executable closed authority. The instance is exactly one wire or projection variant.

x-aiow-lifecycle.acceptedNonReplayMutation: increments revision exactly once; stamps configured actor ID and server time; writes one immutable audit row atomically
x-aiow-lifecycle.replay: returns original outcome with no revision check or residue
x-aiow-lifecycle.markRead: unread true to false only; false to false is rejected as no-op
x-aiow-lifecycle.priority: may change to any priority enum; same value is rejected as no-op
x-aiow-lifecycle.nextActionAt: nullable; non-null must be future server-time ISO timestamp; must be null for won/lost

x-aiow-operator-auth.trustedHostSource: platform-verified deployment hostname compared to exact server allowlist; never trust Host or X-Forwarded-Host alone
x-aiow-operator-auth.customProductionDomain: 404 before auth or data for UI, API, exports, and PII assets
x-aiow-operator-auth.secret: configured strong secret; missing/malformed configuration fails closed
x-aiow-operator-auth.vercelSso: outer additional gate; never sole authority

checks.name: commercial_leads_terminal_next_action_ck
checks.expression: status not in ('won','lost') or next_action_at is null

columns.commercial_lead_id: uuid not null unique fk commercial_leads(id) on delete cascade
uuid not null fk commercial_leads(id) on delete cascade
uuid null fk commercial_leads(id) on delete set null

compatibility.quoteBackfill: each quote_leads row maps one-to-one to commercial_leads via quote_leads.commercial_lead_id
compatibility.v1OutboxCutover: mail_outbox v1 receives no new jobs after commercial_mail_outbox v2 activation; historical jobs drain under v1 compatibility worker

quoteAlterations.activation: backfill all rows then set not null

x-aiow-quote-lifecycle.prepare: atomically creates quote-specific row and common commercial lead; excludes prepared lead from queue, unread, SLA and analytics
x-aiow-quote-lifecycle.commit: atomically stores PDF and exactly customer_quote plus internal_lead v2 jobs and committed transition
x-aiow-quote-lifecycle.prepareReplay: same digest returns original prepare ACK; changed digest 409
x-aiow-quote-lifecycle.commitReplay: same digest returns original committed ACK before state/revision checks; zero residue
x-aiow-quote-lifecycle.deliveryAuthority: only QuoteCommitACK with pdfDeliveryPermitted=true permits PDF delivery

x-aiow-outbox.payload: closed and immutable; SHA-256 digest checked on every transition

lease.claim: pending/retry due to leased by CAS
lease.finalize: lease token + unexpired lease + expected revision CAS

x-aiow-outbox.acceptedGraph: HTTP 202 requires acceptanceKind and attemptReceipt; providerMessageId may be null

x-aiow-provider-gate.runtimeCapability: mail_send only when activated and evidence current for exact target
x-aiow-provider-gate.activation: external separate owner gate; contract approval does not activate

x-aiow-analytics.experiment: experiment_exposed only after rendered; conversion events quote_succeeded, booking_succeeded and scan_cta_clicked count only with same server-validated experimentId and variant
x-aiow-analytics.aggregate: closed daily buckets; no person-level rows

x-aiow-retention.activation: dry-run only; destructive activation is separate owner gate
x-aiow-retention.legalHold: ops_admin only; expected revision, idempotency key, nonempty reason and audit required

preserve: common lead non-PII identity until audit expiry
